logline: A solitary middle schooler who fills his library notebook with dark fantasies about his popular classmate gradually discovers that the girl everyone admires is as strange and sincere as he is - and falls completely in love.

renewal.note: Season 3 has been officially announced for 2027. The series continues to expand its audience through HIDIVE and Aniplus Asia after Season 2 won the Anime Corner and Anime Trending anime of the year awards for 2024.

bollymeter.basis: Season 1 established the premise and the central dynamic with enough charm that it built a devoted audience ahead of Season 2. Critics praised the subversion of the hostile-narrator-who-is-actually-tender formula without inflating a quiet show into something it is not.

seasons.review_body: The Dangers in My Heart premiered on TV Asahi in April 2023 as an adaptation of Norio Sakurai's manga, distributed internationally via HIDIVE. The premise is built on a structural irony: Kyotaro Ichikawa's inner monologue is genuinely dark - he catalogues fantasies of social violence - but his actual behaviour, particularly toward popular classmate Anna Yamada, is defined by awkwardness and careful tenderness. Season 1 works as a slow burn in the most literal sense: the comedy is in the gap between what Kyotaro thinks and what he does, and the payoff requires patience. Critics who picked up the series noted the animation was modest by 2023 standards but the character writing was unusually precise. The season builds its audience rather than announcing itself - Season 2 is where the critical recognition arrived.

bollymeter.basis: Season 2 became the first anime in the history of Anime Corner and Anime Trending polling to rank first every single week of an entire season. It won Best Anime of the Year at the 2024 Anime Corner Awards and was nominated at the 2025 Crunchyroll Awards for Best Romance and Best Slice of Life.

pull_quotes.text: Dangers is so tightly packed that it can fit so many delightful scenes into a single episode, plus it looks gorgeous while doing so.

seasons.review_body: The Dangers in My Heart Season 2 aired in Winter 2024 and became one of the year's most discussed romance anime by any metric available. Anime Corner and Anime Trending both recorded it as the first title in their polling histories to hold the top weekly rank for an entire season without interruption. The Crunchyroll Awards nominated it for Best Romance and Best Slice of Life. Season 2 escalates the Kyotaro-Anna relationship from tentative proximity to something that requires both characters to confront what they actually feel - the payoff of eighteen episodes of careful setup. ANN critic Kevin Cormack noted the season's density: it packs delightful moments efficiently without padding. The animation quality improved noticeably over Season 1. For viewers beginning the series, watching both seasons consecutively is the recommended approach - Season 2's emotional weight is earned through Season 1's slow foundation.
seasons.season_over_season: Season 2 is the series operating at full confidence - the romantic escalation the first season carefully prepared lands with precision, and the critical response was proportionately decisive.

episode_reviews.title: My Heart's Dangers Are Gone
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The Season 2 finale delivers the romantic resolution the series has been building toward across 25 episodes. Critics noted that the episode earns its conclusion by staying true to both characters - the awkwardness does not disappear, it simply becomes something the two of them share.
episode_reviews.the_moment: The moment Kyotaro stops narrating his fears and acts - the gap between his inner voice and his actual behaviour finally closes.
